WEST FARGO, N.D. (NewsDakota.com) – The Cass County Historical Society invites brave visitors, history enthusiasts, and curious investigators to step beyond the barriers and experience the darker side of Red River Valley history during its exclusive Paranormal Investigation Tours on October 10th,16th,17th,23rd,24th, 30th, and, of course, Halloween Night!

Spanning 12 acres and featuring 34 historic pioneer buildings filled with hundreds of thousands of authentic artifacts, Bonanzaville has long served as a preservation hub for North Dakota’s heritage. However, staff, volunteers, and visitors alike have frequently reported unexplained occurrences—from echoing footsteps in empty halls to disembodied voices and objects that appear to move on their own in some of the region’s oldest structures.

During these guided 90-minute investigations, participants will venture past traditional museum barriers into reportedly active historic locations across the grounds. Attendees are encouraged to bring their own approved ghost-hunting equipment—such as EMF detectors, digital audio recorders, and infrared thermometers—or utilize guided investigative techniques led by experienced staff.
